question: When did you last test your site on a phone?
instagram_caption:
Daily Tech Talk #32 💡

Visitors on mobile leave fast.
If your site takes seconds too long to load on a phone, potential clients bounce before they even see your offer.

Speed isn't just about code quality. Heavy images, unoptimized scripts, and bloated plugins add invisible weight that mobile processors struggle to handle.

When did you last test your site on a phone? Tell us in the comments 👇

linkedin_post:
A slow mobile website doesn't just test patience. It deletes customers.

When someone lands on your site from a phone, they expect it to load instantly. If it stutters or stalls, they don't wait. They tap the back button and call your competitor instead.

Too many businesses focus entirely on desktop design while ignoring how their pages perform on a standard smartphone over a cellular connection. Heavy images, unoptimized layouts, and too many third-party scripts quietly drain your conversion rate.

Audit your mobile speed today. Trim the weight, simplify the layout, and keep the visitors you worked hard to attract.
